title: Stability-band specification and degradation handling for pinned model versions
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Define a concise, machine-readable 'stability band' and associated degradation handling policies for pinned model versions. This ticket specifies the tolerance windows for IO (prompt format, parameter aliases, and output shape), quantitative acceptance thresholds for token-level and semantic regressions, and the operational steps when a pinned version falls outside its stability band. The goal is to provide a deterministic onboarding checklist and a public performance profile (latency/throughput/quality) that customers can rely on when pinning a model version.
acceptance_criteria: Stability-band schema defined and checked into /confluence/model-onboarding/stability-band-spec (link below)
Tolerance matrix includes numeric thresholds for: token-level change (KL divergence proxy), normalized BLEU/ROUGE/semantic similarity, length-distribution shift, and top-k token probability drift
IO compatibility gate implemented in onboarding pipeline: rejects versions that break required prompt fields or output JSON schema beyond permitted fuzz tolerance
Degradation handling flow documented and automated: alerting + automatic canary rollback or soft-fallback routing to compatible variant
Performance profile generation integrated into onboarding pipeline: publishes p50/p90/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost-per-token to the model catalog
Regression harness runs sample prompts and publishes diff artifacts to the eval dashboard for review
Docs and customer-facing summary created for Console release notes (runtime-1.20)

operational_notes: Breach severity mapping: high = quality drop >5% semantic-similarity AND latency regression >30%; medium = either quality OR latency exceeds tolerance; low = small statistical drift within band
On breach: automated route to compatible variant for 30 minutes while alerting SRE and the model owner
Keep retention of perf artifacts for pinned versions for 180 days
Owners: Model-onboarding team for gating logic, Runtime team for performance profiler, Console team for UX/alerts
